title: 'They are wrong': Defence minister denies US report on AUKUS submarines
paragraphs: The US Congressional Budget Office has found AUKUS would strain an already-struggling US Navy.
Australia's Defence Minister, Richard Marles, says "they are wrong" and production is improving.
Mr Marles said the government would work with the US after Donald Trump threatened "tremendous taxes" for tech companies that build AI data centres overseas.
